excerpt.zh: 凡世间的国度并不如其看上去那么坚固。那些居住在里面的人也是这样。你身边人的秘密都展现在了我们面前。我们了解到的事情现在都交给你了。
excerpt.en: The corporeal realm is not as solid as it appears. So it is with those who dwell within. The secrets of your peers have been revealed to us. What we have learned is now yours.
